contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances that name pornographic material containing a minor, or that name the same pornographic material with adults only. It exists so a judge can be trained that both child_sexual_exploitation and sexual_content fire when pornographic content involves a minor. Items are composed locally. No generation prompt for child_sexual_exploitation is ever sent to any model.
note: Composition exists so the deciding feature stays locked. Existing CSE duals teach an act clause (suck, lick, cum) next to a minor, or named CSAM plus a naked scene. The residual miss is a caption: named porn plus an in-text minor, with no act vocabulary. The model emits child_sexual_exploitation and drops sexual_content. Pornographic content independently meets sexual_content. Adult porn without a minor is sexual_content alone. Do not add a CSE-alone of porn plus minor: porn independently meets sexual_content. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: Named pornographic material plus a minor signalled in the text fires both child_sexual_exploitation and sexual_content. Named pornographic material with adults only is sexual_content alone. Emitting the second label is required when both definitions are independently met.
shape: one or two sentences; locked pair; caption, not an act clause; no meta-language
